name: RiskFactor
description: Displays risk level with color-coded icons and badges based on integer risk score thresholds

configOptions.name: lowThreshold
configOptions.label: Low Risk Threshold
configOptions.description: Maximum score for low risk (0 to this value)

configOptions.name: highThreshold
configOptions.label: High Risk Threshold
configOptions.description: Minimum score for high risk (this value to 100)

configOptions.name: showLabel
configOptions.label: Show Risk Label
configOptions.description: Display the risk level text label

configOptions.name: iconSize
configOptions.label: Icon Size
configOptions.description: Size of the risk icon (small, medium, large)
